title: STNFS at relation excess 1.1 with per-side factor-base bounds 2^69.25/2^69, line sieve to 2^48 and band strip, f-first ECM, weight-200 merge, ten LA owners, sub-bin pr, skewed boot, fresh on-region pool, explicit purge-loss charge, re-measured filtering: 120.213628275286

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the complete STNFS algorithm (proof.md, DESCENT.md, REFINEMENT.md) with 99.9% ECM, X2 = 2^64, factor-base bounds 2^69.25 on the f side and 2^69 on the g side (U = 2^63.5788 sigma-orbits), required relation excess 1.1 (the whole region is collected; every retained relation, >= 2^63.8197 = 1.182 U, is filtered and used by the descent; the matrix is charged at excess 1.1, an over-estimate of N), theta = 2284/8000 collection on a fresh 164,000-draw pool at theta 5/16 (rows with qa < 0.02 give no yield, cells still charged), the measured record route, recentred slice12 kernels (KERNELS.md), f-first early abort, the weight-200 merge and the STORAGE.md/row_tail.c kernels with ten active owners returns Q satisfying e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P, with success at least 0.39 under disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (H4u: >= 88% of filtered row weight is +-1, measured at weights 100/200, excess 1.1; weight-200 ratio <= 0.801 and N/U not rising above the measured 2^15..2^18 values are part of H3). It computes two GT logarithms and returns Q=[a]Q0, handling z=1 directly. All classical work is bounded by a global meter at 2^120.213628275286 dense-Fp12 units, C=20,000 instructions, with upper-rounded ledger rows summing to 2^120.2136282752853289 (70-digit decimal arithmetic), below the declared 2^120.213628275286. ECM succeeds with 99.9% per prime; theta=2284/8000 (14987 rows, a-radius 773; relations >= 2^63.8197, 0.1034 bits = 2.01 pool SE above 1.1 U; descent input 63.716 = estimate - 2 SE) with slacks (295, 226), allowance 1.0173, line sieve (scores only) below 2^48 and record walk for [2^48, 2^64), survivors stripping (2^20, 2^48] primes by two 48-bit ECM rounds per side (a miss loses the relation, charged in the yield), then the ecm16 schedule for primes up to the side's bound (2^69.25 f, 2^69 g), alpha (5.15, 0.85), primes in [2^63, 2^64) charged twice, records routed at 10.01 and re-read at 7.003; g-side band strip and ECM run only after f factors, with probability q_f = 100 rho(u_f)/P(omitted_f <= slack_f) per row: collection <= 2^119.8467 units (309.4 instructions per cell). The polynomials, factor-base bound, filtering, kernels and target are the cited source's; the 62-node descent plan (90d99567 re-optimised at sub-bin pr, skewed boot, LOG2_RELS = 63.599, re-evaluated at 63.716 with the per-side occurrence model and the >= 3-occurrence purge losses charged at the pooled toy rates H3_RATE (H5n): 41 entries move; refinement.json) is evaluated at UDUP = 0.65 and THIN_MAX 85. Linear algebra (mean weight 201, 20.7 per sparse entry, 1,640 per row, 97 per dense term, 420 per 9-limb reduction, N = 0.801 x 1.0954 x 0.0565292 U = 2^59.2453 < 10 x 2^56 at excess 1.1 on the per-side filtering system, blocks (19, 4)) is <= 2^118.0102 units, generator <= 2^107.3116. Descent credits UDUP = 0.65 distinct relations per raw relation (E[shat/m]/pr_charged >= 0.87 boot (complete-orbit recount) / >= 1.12 nodes (4.70 over the 4x cap with haircut), uniform cells; boot reduced in the weighted metric, certified exactly), discards only up to 2^90, and keeps 18 boot relations. Expected two-log work is bounded by 2^112.119; the two-log meter is 2^113.119; Markov abort probability is <= 0.5. Other upper bounds are boot failure 1.000e-03 per log (charged 499x the H5 model value), expected nodes 2^16.47, node abort 2^-10.83 and repeats 2^-10.70, with 2/r statistical distance charged. All preprocessing, failures, advice, arithmetic, transfers, sorting, verification and output are included; nothing amortized. Certificate construction gets an extra 2^50-unit allowance. Memory is at most 2^105 bytes. Source smoothness and production extrapolations stay explicit heuristics. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Bounded audit of recorded full-recurrence evidence, upward-rounded ledger and success, unchanged prime-window endpoints, and nonzero lower/upper integration controls. Does not rerun the full recurrence.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py, per-side bounds) at relation excess 1.1 (default; optional 'excess') to mean weight 100 or 200 (default 200) and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.88) and U/N. Optional (the hosted initial run is the bounded audit). Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).

Optional full recomputation of certificates, region, ledger (recentred kernels, early abort, weight-200 LA, ten-owner row tail with owner_schedule check), retention, ECM, descent and declared bounds (about 125 s natively; longer when emulated).
